sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: FLAG-tagged WT ILDR1 localizes correctly to tricellular contacts in LSR-knockdown cells, co-distributing with tricellulin and claudin-3; surface display confirmed by non-permeabilized anti-FLAG immunostaining. Correct junctional localization is the established functional readout for this scaffolding receptor.
sites.rationale: ILDR1 has a single extracellular span (residues 24–170) and a single-pass type I topology; the only extracellular terminus is the mature N-terminus beginning at residue 24 (L). Anti-FLAG surface immunostaining of the Q195X truncation mutant (which eliminates the C-terminal intracellular tail) confirms the FLAG is N-terminal, not C-terminal. Python verification confirms residue 23 = S (last signal-peptide residue) and residue 24 = L (first mature-protein residue), placing the tag junction at insert_after_residue = 23, 147 residues from the TM boundary (171), well within the safe distance. Full-length human ILDR1 was subcloned into pCAG-cFLAG2 and stably expressed in LSR-knockdown epithelial cells; anti-FLAG mAb immunostaining (without permeabilization) confirmed surface display and correct localization to tricellular tight junctions. The Q195X truncation mutant (which removes most of the intracellular C-terminal tail) retains anti-FLAG immunostaining, demonstrating the FLAG tag is N-terminal rather than C-terminal. ILDR1 is a type I single-pass TM protein (N-out, C-in); the only extracellular terminus is the mature N-terminus after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 23. The junction is therefore after residue 23 (S) and before residue 24 (L).

sources.claim: (B) LSR knockdown cells stably expressing the mock FLAG vector (C) or wild-type (WT) human ILDR1.

literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) derive from the same study (PMC4323246) and describe the same pCAG-cFLAG2-ILDR1 construct. No ledger line explicitly states the residue number of the FLAG insertion. The position is topology-derived: ILDR1 is a type I TM protein with a single extracellular N-terminus; anti-FLAG surface immunostaining (non-permeabilized) and retention of the FLAG epitope in the Q195X intracellular-truncation mutant together establish that the FLAG is N-terminal (after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 23). The C-terminus (residue 546) is intracellular and is not a surface-tag site; it is not separately reported in the ledger as a tested position. No internal extracellular loop insertions are reported in the ledger. No ledger line qualifies as a validated exact-residue site (no residue number is named for the junction), so position_evidence is topology_derived throughout.
